subsystems.name: Sensing layer
subsystems.role: measures conditions across the city — traffic, air quality, energy, water, waste and noise.

subsystems.name: Connectivity layer
subsystems.role: carries sensor data to central systems.

subsystems.name: Data platform
subsystems.role: ingests, stores and normalises data from many sources.

subsystems.name: Analytics and control
subsystems.role: turns data into decisions and automated actions.

subsystems.name: Actuation layer
subsystems.role: adjusts city infrastructure in response to data.

buildSteps.title: Define use cases and outcomes
buildSteps.detail: Choose specific problems — congestion, energy waste, air quality — and set measurable targets.

buildSteps.title: Survey and plan sensor placement
buildSteps.detail: Map where devices will go, how they will be powered (mains, battery, solar) and how data will reach the network.

buildSteps.title: Deploy sensors and meters
buildSteps.detail: Install devices on poles, in buildings and underground, commissioning each one and recording its location.

buildSteps.title: Establish connectivity
buildSteps.detail: Set up gateways and network coverage, test data transmission and latency.

buildSteps.title: Build the data platform
buildSteps.detail: Create ingestion pipelines, storage and APIs so data from different vendors can be combined.

buildSteps.title: Develop analytics and applications
buildSteps.detail: Write algorithms for traffic optimisation, predictive maintenance or energy shifting, and build dashboards for operators.

buildSteps.title: Integrate with city systems
buildSteps.detail: Connect to traffic management, SCADA, billing and emergency systems so actions can be taken automatically or by staff.

buildSteps.title: Pilot and evaluate
buildSteps.detail: Run a limited deployment, measure against targets, and fix issues of reliability, privacy and user acceptance.

buildSteps.title: Scale and maintain
buildSteps.detail: Roll out city-wide, train staff, and set up ongoing maintenance and cybersecurity updates.

prerequisites.why: sensors need cheap, long-range, battery-friendly connectivity.
to store and process the volume of data without building huge local data centres.
many devices have weak security, and a hacked city network can affect physical infrastructure.
city data can reveal personal behaviour, so anonymisation and rules are needed.
without common data models, systems from different vendors cannot work together.

pathway.milestone: siloed deployments such as smart street lighting, parking and meter reading in individual departments
pathway.unlocks: proven savings and familiarisation with the technology.

pathway.milestone: shared data platform and APIs across departments
pathway.unlocks: cross-domain insights, such as linking air quality to traffic flow.

pathway.milestone: AI-driven traffic control and predictive maintenance
pathway.unlocks: real-time optimisation and fewer infrastructure failures.

pathway.milestone: city-scale digital twin and personalised citizen services
pathway.unlocks: simulation of policies before roll-out and better quality of life.
